manual_measurements.subtitle: Enter your measurements to estimate body fat
manual_measurements.field_chest_hint: Around the fullest part of the chest, tape level under the arms
manual_measurements.field_waist_hint: At the narrowest point, usually just above the navel
manual_measurements.field_hips_hint: At the widest point of the hips/glutes
manual_measurements.field_neck_hint: Just below the larynx, sloping slightly downward
manual_measurements.error_fill: Please enter at least waist and neck measurements.
manual_measurements.error_required_msg: Chest, waist, hips, and neck measurements are required.

guide_items.label: Chest
guide_items.tip: Wrap the tape around the fullest part of your chest, level under the arms. Keep the tape snug but not tight.

guide_items.label: Waist
guide_items.tip: Measure at the narrowest point, usually just above the navel. Breathe normally, don't suck in.

guide_items.label: Hips
guide_items.tip: Measure at the widest point of your hips/glutes, feet together, tape parallel to the floor.

guide_items.label: Neck
guide_items.tip: Measure just below the larynx (Adam's apple), sloping slightly downward.

guide_items.label: Thighs
guide_items.tip: Measure at the middle of the thigh between hip and knee.

guide_items.label: Arms
guide_items.tip: Flex bicep and measure at the peak of the muscle.
